title: Spending more on health buys no extra years of life
description: Health spending per person (USD) vs life expectancy at birth, six countries, latest OECD figures. The United States spends the most and lives the least among this set.
insight: Past a modest level of investment, additional health spending adds no years — the United States spends three times more than Korea and lives one year less.
